exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 7193 mothers who gave birth in Ethiopia, including 256 who underwent cesarean section
finding: Factors associated with cesarean section in Ethiopia included delivery in a private institution, higher maternal education level, longer preceding birth interval, multiple pregnancy, larger child size, and residence in Addis Ababa.
birth_weight: Described as "large size the child", specific birth weight not mentioned
